user_instruction: 验收 D1—D4，按照方案执行 D5
hypothesis: 2024 mean alpha reduction 100 to 1 increased finite historical-event sensitivity; hard mean gate amplified error into trades. Fixed100 is a single counterfactual, not causal proof or independent validation.

changed_variable.objective: sum squared R5 residuals + alpha times squared coefficients; unpenalized intercept

fixed: All 73 original mature monthly training memberships
Original R5 conditional mean target and prediction clipping at -1
Published Q90/P10 and their raw values
Original timing, requested service dates, label maturity and score_observed
Original B=.05, single-sided c=.0005, gate mu>2c, target B/Q capped1, cash0, capital100000
No grid, no other model or intervention
prediction_controls: Refit all73 with alpha100 and independently solve; original-alpha100 published means copied exactly after numerical identity verification. Only2024 has changed forecasts. Do not overwrite accepted outputs.
scoring: Only original score_observed rows, published mu5 MSE; preserve original cross2024 and unripe tails. All/year/quarter calendar groups. Paired squared-error differences D5-original. No selection after scores.
event_diagnostics: Reuse all1260 original monthly mature event clusters and deletion identities. Compare original vs alpha100 fixed-original-transform deletion, and separately full-transform deletion using each accepted D3 saved deletion transform. No event deleted from production fit or evaluation. Save all pairwise changed predictions. No target replacement intervention.
stability_metrics: cluster maximum/RMS absolute raw mean change
effective degrees of freedom excluding intercept and penalized condition
conditional fixed-design Newey-West prediction SE, lags21/63; no bias/selection/transform uncertainty included
account_comparators: original M2 risk-only (also exact D5 risk-only)
account_paths: Each scope rebuilt from common100000 cash at original execution close; all strategies same start/end and same original calendar. Years/quarters slice continuous paths, no recapitalization; holding PnL precedes current trade. Missing forecast holds actual shares. No forced final liquidation.
account_metrics: local-period max drawdown incl opening equity
fees, turnover, worst daily and compounded5-session return within period
target jumps and gate crossings, paired per-date chain, holding-PnL and cost change

bootstrap.algorithm: paired circular calendar blocks; same indices for both models, no compression of missing labels; per all/year/quarter. MSE difference mean over observed selections; sparse empty draws kept missing with valid counts. Account realized return paths sampled as pairs, compute mean daily difference, compounded return difference and max-drawdown difference; conditional on realized trading/costs, not reoptimized tradable bootstrap paths. 95% percentile intervals; overlapping five-day labels and post-reveal multiple comparisons are not independent evidence.
bootstrap.short_period_rule: When full period has fewer sessions than requested21/63, keep period point metrics but report that block interval unavailable; do not shrink block or pad sample. Recorded before first D5 calculation.

interpretation: Profit-only improvement without MSE/stability does not establish estimator repair. MSE/stability without economy does not rescue trading. Preserve every year/quarter and worse cases, including alpha100 control years. No automatic second intervention/promotion/funding.
dependencies: Existing Python3.12.13/.venv; no installs, downloads or accounts.
